title: Prosperity: Accelerating Spiking Neural Networks via Product Sparsity
problem: Existing SNN accelerators exploit bit sparsity (zero-valued spikes) to skip zero multiplications, but this approach leaves substantial redundancy unexploited: non-zero spike patterns that produce structurally identical inner products across matrix rows are recomputed independently, wasting significant compute.
motivation: SNNs are promising for ultra-efficient edge AI due to their event-driven spike computation, but realizing their full efficiency potential requires moving beyond simple bit-sparsity exploitation to capture combinatorial reuse patterns in sparse binary matrix multiplication.
method: Spiking neural networks transmit information using binary signals where neurons either fire or stay silent at each time step. Product Sparsity recognizes that whenever multiple output neurons receive the same pattern of input firings, they must produce identical outputs—but existing systems compute this result independently for each neuron, wasting computation. Prosperity groups neurons by their input firing patterns using a real-time pattern-matching engine, computes the weighted sum (inner product) once per unique pattern, and reuses that single result for all neurons with matching patterns. This optimization applies to both fully-connected and convolutional layers in SNNs with binary activations.
key_novelty: Product Sparsity reuses inner product results across neurons with matching binary input firing patterns instead of computing them separately for each neuron.
contributions: Product Sparsity: a new sparsity paradigm exploiting combinatorial similarity in binary spike patterns for computation reuse
11x reduction in computation for SpikeBERT vs bit sparsity alone (density 1.23% vs 13.19%)
Prosperity ASIC architecture with real-time pattern matching and result reuse engine
7.4x speedup and 8.0x energy efficiency over prior SNN accelerator PTB; 1.8x speedup and 193x energy efficiency over A100

metrics.speedup: 7.4x over PTB SNN accelerator; 1.8x over A100 GPU
metrics.energy_or_tops_w: 8.0x energy efficiency over PTB; 193x energy efficiency over A100

limitations: Product Sparsity benefit depends on the degree of pattern repetition in activation maps, which may vary significantly across SNN model architectures and input distributions.
primary_theme: Product sparsity for SNN acceleration via combinatorial inner product reuse
